title: Spectacular Wonders
subject: English
summary: “Spectacular Wonders” is an informative chapter about seven amazing natural wonders of India. It describes the beautiful Valley of Flowers in Uttarakhand, the Living Root Bridges of Meghalaya, the Lonar Crater Lake in Maharashtra, the Magnetic Hills in Ladakh, the glowing waters of Kerala, the Sundarbans in West Bengal and the disappearing beach of Chandipur in Odisha. Each place is special because of its unique natural beauty and interesting scientific features. Some places look magical, such as the glowing waters at night and vehicles appearing to move uphill at Magnetic Hills. The chapter helps us understand the wonders of nature and the science behind them. It teaches us that we should explore, appreciate and protect our natural wonders for future generations.
